learning_objective: 🎯 Let's learn how to become amazing storytellers by using only our drawings and colors to narrate exciting tales!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every great story needs a hero or a fun character! We can draw characters with special clothes, hairstyles, and props to show who they are.
Characters need to show feelings! We can change the shape of their eyebrows, eyes, and mouth to make them look happy, sad, surprised, or angry.
A sequence means putting pictures in order. Just like a comic book, we draw the beginning of the story in the first box, the middle in the next, and the end last.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Create a 3-Panel Comic Strip!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a paper and divide it into three boxes. Draw a short story about a hungry dog finding a bone, making sure to show what happens first, next, and last!

quick_recap: ⭐ Storytelling art uses pictures instead of words to tell a tale.
⭐ Changing a character's face helps us understand their emotions.
⭐ Putting drawings in a sequence helps the story make sense from start to finish.
